description: This file defines an internal class 'MultiTaskCompletionSource' that provides a mechanism to create a task that completes after receiving a specified number of signals, acting as an advanced multi-signal task completion utility.

classes.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
classes.description: An alternative to TaskCompletionSource that completes after a specified number of signals have been received.

methods.name: MultiTaskCompletionSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the multi-signal completion source with a specified count, throwing an exception if the count is less than or equal to zero.

methods.name: Task
methods.description: Property that provides the task which completes when the required number of signals are received.

methods.name: SetOneResult
methods.description: Method to signal one occurrence; throws if called more times than the initial count, and completes the task when the count reaches zero.
